particleEffectFamilyTuningContracts.description: Room-wide falling rain with recipe-authored drops and landing ripples.

controls.name: EmissionRateMultiplier
controls.description: Uniformly scales ratePerSecond on every applicable authored stream, preserving relative stream rates. Omitted means the neutral multiplier 1. Zero suppresses continuous rate-based emission.
controls.label: Emission rate multiplier
controls.bindingBehavior: Multiply each applicable stream ratePerSecond by this factor.

controls.name: LifetimeMultiplier
controls.description: Scales both authored lifeMinSeconds and lifeMaxSeconds on every eligible stream, preserving each stream range and differences between streams. Omitted means the neutral multiplier 1. Zero is omitted, preserving recipe-authored lifetimes and avoiding immediate onDeathStreamId follow-ups. A stream with lifetimeTuningApplicable false is excluded; true opts it in; when absent, it participates by default. Point-spawned onDeathStreamId follow-ups are explicitly excluded unless opted in.
controls.label: Lifetime multiplier
controls.bindingBehavior: Multiply authored lifeMinSeconds and lifeMaxSeconds on each eligible stream; preserve range shape and stream-to-stream differences.

controls.name: SizeMultiplier
controls.label: Size multiplier
controls.description: Uniformly scales the authored particle size curve on every stream in this family, including optional end dimensions; for surface-mark, scales the recipe-authored sizePx. Omitted means the neutral multiplier 1. Zero is omitted, preserving authored dimensions and avoiding invisible particles that still consume simulation capacity.
controls.bindingBehavior: Multiply authored startWidthPx and startHeightPx and, when present, endWidthPx and endHeightPx on each stream by this factor; for surface-mark, multiply recipe sizePx by the same factor.

controls.name: Colors
controls.bindingBehavior: palette

controls.name: WindSpeedMultiplier
controls.bindingBehavior: Multiply the resolved environmental wind vector magnitude for this effect by this factor.
controls.label: Wind speed multiplier
controls.description: Scales the effect response to the resolved environmental WindSpeedPxPerSecond input; it does not replace or alter that input. Omitted means the neutral multiplier 1. Zero removes this effect wind response.

controls.name: WindDirectionOffsetDegrees
controls.bindingBehavior: Add this relative angle to a valid resolved wind direction; calm direction remains calm.
controls.description: Relative signed angular offset applied to the resolved environmental WindDirectionDegrees. Omitted means 0 degrees. It does not replace the environmental direction.

controls.name: WindSpeedPxPerSecond
controls.bindingBehavior: Use as the effect resolved environmental wind-speed input before applying WindSpeedMultiplier.
controls.description: Absolute resolved environmental wind-speed input in room pixels per second. It supplies the effect wind state; WindSpeedMultiplier separately scales this effect response.

controls.name: WindDirectionDegrees
controls.bindingBehavior: Use as the resolved environmental wind direction before applying WindDirectionOffsetDegrees.
controls.description: Absolute resolved environmental wind direction in screen-space degrees; -1 denotes calm. WindDirectionOffsetDegrees is a separate relative transform.

controls.name: EmissionRateMultiplier
controls.description: Uniformly scales ratePerSecond on every applicable authored stream, preserving relative stream rates. Omitted means the neutral multiplier 1. Zero suppresses continuous rate-based emission.

controls.bindingBehavior: Multiply each applicable stream ratePerSecond by this factor.

controls.name: LifetimeMultiplier
controls.description: Scales both authored lifeMinSeconds and lifeMaxSeconds on every eligible stream, preserving each stream range and differences between streams. Omitted means the neutral multiplier 1. Zero is omitted, preserving recipe-authored lifetimes and avoiding immediate onDeathStreamId follow-ups. A stream with lifetimeTuningApplicable false is excluded; true opts it in; when absent, it participates by default. Point-spawned onDeathStreamId follow-ups are explicitly excluded unless opted in.
controls.label: Lifetime multiplier
controls.bindingBehavior: Multiply authored lifeMinSeconds and lifeMaxSeconds on each eligible stream; preserve range shape and stream-to-stream differences.

controls.bindingBehavior: Compute clamp(recipe.opacity * this factor, 0, 1); do not replace authored opacity.
